description: Constants enforced by core. Integers are strings of base units.

errors.INVALID_REQUEST: The request is malformed or a field is invalid.
errors.PAYMENT_BELOW_MINIMUM: Payment amount is below the $0.001 minimum.
errors.RECEIVER_TOKEN_ACCOUNT_MISSING: The payee token account or the treasury USDC account does not exist. Accounts are never created inside a payment.
errors.QUOTE_EXPIRED: The quote has expired or was already used. Request a new quote.
errors.QUOTE_INVALID: The quote signature does not match the m2m.monster service key.
errors.MINT_NOT_ALLOWED: The token mint is not in the whitelist for this network.
errors.FEE_BALANCE_INSUFFICIENT_USDC: The payer does not hold enough USDC to pay the fee. The fee is always paid in USDC.
errors.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION_INVALID: The transaction is not the m2m-split transaction described by the quote.
errors.TRANSACTION_FAILED: The transaction failed on-chain or was not confirmed in time.
errors.RECEIPT_INVALID: The receipt is not signed by the m2m.monster service key or does not match the transaction on-chain.
errors.CHALLENGE_INVALID: The registration challenge is missing, expired, already used, or not signed by this public key.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: The idempotency key was already used for a different request.
